hook: Amba Kak is co-executive director of the AI Now Institute, where she works on policy responses to the concentration of power in the AI industry. She trained as a lawyer in India, then won a Rhodes Scholarship to Oxford, where she earned a Master's in Law and an MSc in the Social Science of the Internet. Early in her career she advised India's telecom regulator, TRAI, on net neutrality, then worked as a global policy advisor at Mozilla. She later joined the US Federal Trade Commission as a senior advisor on AI, a role she held through 2022, before returning to lead the AI Now Institute alongside Sarah Myers West. Since then she has testified before Congress, represented civil society at the UK's first AI Safety Summit, and addressed the UN General Assembly on AI governance, arguing that unchecked AI development is concentrating power in a small number of technology companies.
